extDescription.message: Sends your downloads to the free SwiftGet download manager and finds videos and audio on web pages.

btnNoMedia.message: Play the video for a moment, then click again.

optButton.message: Show a "Download this video" button over videos

popupStartApp.message: Start SwiftGet on your computer. Until then, downloads stay in the browser.

popupMediaEmpty.message: Play a video or audio on this page and it will show up here.

popupMediaOff.message: Media detection is turned off in Settings.

optCatch.message: Catch downloads and send them to SwiftGet

optMenu.message: Show "Download with SwiftGet" in the right-click menu

optMedia.message: Find videos and audio on web pages

optTypesHint.message: Separate with spaces. Leave empty to catch every download.

optMinSizeHint.message: Smaller downloads stay in the browser. 0 means no limit.

optExcludedHint.message: One per line, for example example.com. Downloads from these sites stay in the browser.

optPortHint.message: Must match Options → Connections → Browser connection port in SwiftGet (default 47321).
